sloka: पातिताश्च त्वया वीराः कृतं कर्म सुदुष्करम्।भक्षितानि च सैन्यानि प्राप्तं ते परमं यशः ।। ६.६७.५६ ।।
transliteration: pātitāśca tvayā vīrāḥ kṛtaṁ karma suduṣkaram।bhakṣitāni ca sainyāni prāptaṁ te paramaṁ yaśaḥ ।। 6.67.56 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva spoke these words seeing Kumbhakarna who stood smeared with the blood of Vanaras and eating monkeys.
